description.value: The Central is a nightclub and bar in Fernie, BC, housed in one of the only buildings to survive the town's catastrophic fire of 1908. Owned and operated by the Himalayan Spice Bistro, it functions as Fernie's primary live music and dance venue, hosting touring and local acts throughout the year. Touring cyclists looking for a lively evening stop in a venue with genuine local history will find it here.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms The Central is a real, operating nightclub and bar in Fernie at the OSM address (301 2 Ave, V0B 1M0), with upcoming events listed for July 2025 and an active social media presence. The phone number (250) 430-0399 appears on the website but is absent from OSM tags. No amenities relevant to the WWC checklist (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: OSM has no phone number; (250) 430-0399 was sourced from the website only.
The booking subpage lists the email as info@thecentralfernie.com while the main page footer lists info@thecentralfernie.ca — minor internal inconsistency on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating, publicly accessible bar and nightclub with an active event calendar and confirmed address — straightforward inclusion.
